mapper.select: INSERT INTO crawl_batch (source_note) VALUES (#{note}) RETURNING batch_id
mapper.update: UPDATE crawl_batch SET status = 'SUCCESS', finished_at = now() WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zh_author (author_id, name, headline) VALUES (#{authorId}, #{authorName}, #{authorHeadline}) ON CONFLICT (author_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT article_id FROM zh_article WHERE url_token = #{token}

INSERT INTO zh_article (url_token, author_id, title, content_type, publish_time) VALUES (#{urlToken}, #{authorId}, #{title}, 'article', coalesce(cast(#{capturedAt} AS timestamptz), now())) RETURNING article_id
SELECT coalesce(max(version_no), 0) FROM article_snapshot WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
SELECT count(*) FROM article_snapshot WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND batch_id = #{batchId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article_snapshot (article_id, version_no, captured_at, batch_id, title, excerpt, content, content_html, voteup_count, comment_count) VALUES (#{articleId}, #{versionNo}, coalesce(cast(#{item.capturedAt} AS timestamptz), now()), #{batchId}, #{item.title}, #{item.excerpt}, #{item.content}, #{item.contentHtml}, coalesce(#{item.voteupCount}, 0), coalesce(#{item.commentCount}, 0)) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
